name: SHA Claims Aging
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Claim:Link/SHA Claim:120",
    patient_name AS "Patient:Data:150",
    service_type AS "Service:Data:100",
    status AS "Status:Data:100",
    IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service) AS "Aged From:Date:100",
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service)) AS "Age (Days):Int:80",
    (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)) AS "Outstanding:Currency:110",
    amount_approved AS "Approved:Currency:110",
    amount_paid AS "Paid:Currency:110",
    rejected_amount AS "Rejected:Currency:110",
    IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service)) <= 30, (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)), 0) AS "0-30:Currency:100",
    IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service)) BETWEEN 31 AND 60, (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)), 0) AS "31-60:Currency:100",
    IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service)) BETWEEN 61 AND 90, (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)), 0) AS "61-90:Currency:100",
    IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service)) BETWEEN 91 AND 120, (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)), 0) AS "91-120:Currency:100",
    IF(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), IFNULL(submission_date, date_of_service)) > 120, (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)), 0) AS "120+:Currency:100"
FROM `tabSHA Claim`
WHERE (amount_claimed - IFNULL(amount_paid, 0) - IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY 6 DESC

name: Monthly Revenue By Service Type
query:
SELECT
    pe.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    pe.mode_of_payment AS "Payment Mode:Link/Mode of Payment:150",
    pe.paid_from AS "Received In:Link/Account:200",
    pe.party AS "Party:Data:150",
    COUNT(pe.name) AS "Transactions:Int:100",
    SUM(pe.paid_amount) AS "Total:Currency:130"
FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
WHERE pe.docstatus = 1
    AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
    AND pe.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
    AND pe.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY pe.posting_date, pe.mode_of_payment, pe.paid_from, pe.party
ORDER BY pe.posting_date DESC, pe.mode_of_payment, pe.party

name: Debtor Aging
query:
SELECT
    si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
    si.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:180",
    si.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    si.due_date AS "Due:Date:100",
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) AS "Days Overdue:Int:100",
    si.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding:Currency:130",
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) <= 0 THEN 'Current'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 91 AND 120 THEN '91-120'
        ELSE '120+'
    END AS "Bucket:Data:100"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
    AND si.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
    AND si.customer NOT IN ('SHA', 'CIC Insurance', 'Kenyatta University Staff Medical Scheme')
ORDER BY si.customer, si.posting_date

name: Daily Cash Report
query:
SELECT
    pe.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    pe.mode_of_payment AS "Payment Mode:Link/Mode of Payment:150",
    pe.paid_from AS "Received In:Link/Account:200",
    pe.party AS "Party:Data:150",
    COUNT(pe.name) AS "Transactions:Int:100",
    SUM(pe.paid_amount) AS "Total:Currency:130"
FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
WHERE pe.docstatus = 1
    AND pe.payment_type = 'Receive'
    AND pe.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
    AND pe.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY pe.posting_date, pe.mode_of_payment, pe.paid_from, pe.party
ORDER BY pe.posting_date DESC, pe.mode_of_payment, pe.party

    pi.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    pi.due_date AS "Due:Date:100",
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pi.due_date) AS "Days Overdue:Int:100",
    pi.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding:Currency:130",
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pi.due_date) <= 0 THEN 'Current'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pi.due_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pi.due_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pi.due_date) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), pi.due_date) BETWEEN 91 AND 120 THEN '91-120'

name: Monthly Payer Mix
query:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS "Month:Data:80",
    CASE
        WHEN sii.income_account LIKE 'SHA Revenue%%' THEN 'SHA'
        WHEN sii.income_account LIKE 'Private Insurance%%' THEN 'Private Insurance'
        ELSE 'Cash/Other'
    END AS "Payer Type:Data:150",
    SUM(sii.amount) AS "Revenue:Currency:130",
    COUNT(DISTINCT si.name) AS "Invoices:Int:100"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
    AND si.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m'),
    CASE
        WHEN sii.income_account LIKE 'SHA Revenue%%' THEN 'SHA'
        WHEN sii.income_account LIKE 'Private Insurance%%' THEN 'Private Insurance'
        ELSE 'Cash/Other'
    END
ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m') DESC, "Payer Type:Data:150"

name: Claim Status Summary
query:
SELECT
    'SHA' AS "Claim Type:Data:100",
    status AS "Status:Data:120",
    COUNT(name) AS "Count:Int:80",
    SUM(amount_claimed) AS "Claimed:Currency:130",
    SUM(IFNULL(amount_approved, 0)) AS "Approved:Currency:130",
    SUM(IFNULL(amount_paid, 0)) AS "Paid:Currency:130",
    SUM(IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)) AS "Rejected:Currency:130"
FROM `tabSHA Claim`
GROUP BY status

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Private Insurance' AS "Claim Type:Data:100",
    status AS "Status:Data:120",
    COUNT(name) AS "Count:Int:80",
    SUM(amount_claimed) AS "Claimed:Currency:130",
    SUM(IFNULL(amount_approved, 0)) AS "Approved:Currency:130",
    SUM(IFNULL(amount_paid, 0)) AS "Paid:Currency:130",
    SUM(IFNULL(rejected_amount, 0)) AS "Rejected:Currency:130"
FROM `tabPrivate Insurance Claim`
GROUP BY status

ORDER BY 1, 2

name: Invoice Summary by Customer
query:
SELECT
    si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
    COUNT(si.name) AS "Total Invoices:Int:120",
    SUM(si.grand_total) AS "Total Billed:Currency:150",
    SUM(si.outstanding_amount) AS "Outstanding:Currency:150",
    SUM(si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount) AS "Paid:Currency:150"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
GROUP BY si.customer
ORDER BY SUM(si.grand_total) DESC

name: Monthly Revenue Trend
query:
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS "Month:Data:80",
    COUNT(DISTINCT si.name) AS "Invoices:Int:100",
    SUM(si.grand_total) AS "Gross Revenue:Currency:150",
    SUM(si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount) AS "Collected:Currency:150",
    SUM(si.outstanding_amount) AS "Outstanding:Currency:150"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
    AND si.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m')
ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m') DESC

name: Supplier  Payment Summary
query:
SELECT
    pe.party AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:200",
    DATE_FORMAT(pe.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS "Month:Data:80",
    pe.mode_of_payment AS "Payment Mode:Link/Mode of Payment:150",
    COUNT(pe.name) AS "Payments:Int:100",
    SUM(pe.paid_amount) AS "Amount:Currency:150"
FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
WHERE pe.docstatus = 1
    AND pe.payment_type = 'Pay'
    AND pe.party_type = 'Supplier'
    AND pe.company = 'St. Scholastica Uzima Hospital'
    AND pe.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY pe.party, DATE_FORMAT(pe.posting_date, '%%Y-%%m'), pe.mode_of_payment
ORDER BY pe.posting_date DESC, pe.party
